method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; seat-neutral cores (rates-core.l4 with five regulative rules, landtax-core.l4 with three, rates-shared.l4 with the TAA objection rule) and a seat layer (rates-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (commercial, rural and airport land, div 5.2 parcels, corporate and trustee owners, a special disability trust, quarters outside 2026-27 and a parcel with no unimproved value each answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Rates Act 2004 (A2004-3), Republication No 45 effective 26 December 2025, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/A2004-3.txt; Land Tax Act 2004 (A2004-4), Republication No 34 effective 26 December 2025; the Taxation Administration (Amounts Payable—Rates) Determination 2026 (DI2026-150) and the Taxation Administration (Amounts Payable—Land Tax) Determination 2026 (DI2026-152), each as notified 30 June 2026, and the Rates (Age 65 or Over—Rates Deferral) Determination 2026 (DI2026-144), as notified 29 June 2026, all commencing 1 July 2026, which set every figure (DI2026-150 Tables 1-2 and DI2026-152 Table 1 encoded as tables); and the Taxation Administration Act 1999 (A1999-4), Republication No 52 effective 26 November 2025. Not deposited, so inputs: the s 21 / s 19 / s 19A interest rate, the TAA s 26 market rate component, the penalty unit value; no s 18(3) discount rate is determined.

encodes_also.au/act/land-tax-act-2004: Land tax is encoded in this folder (landtax-core.l4), because its AUV is the Rates Act s 13A average unimproved value (Land Tax Act s 9(4)) and the stable l4 cannot IMPORT across encoding folders; land-tax-act-2004 has no encoding folder of its own.

checks.result: 189 assertions satisfied (106 in rates-cases-owner.l4, 83 in landtax-cases-owner.l4), 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24); 7 #TRACEs with an expect line (6 breaches by the owner, 1 obligation of the commissioner pending), each read and as expected

scope: From the seat of the owner of a residential parcel or unit in the ACT, for 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027. Rates Act: s 13A, s 14(1)-(3), s 15(1)-(2), s 16, ss 17-19 (a regulative rule), s 18(1), s 20, s 20A(1), s 21, s 29(3)-(5), s 45, s 46(1)-(2), (5) (a regulative rule), s 48, s 49, s 51, s 52(1), s 55(2) (a regulative rule), s 60, s 61 (a regulative rule), s 62, s 63, s 64, s 65, s 67 (a regulative rule), s 69, ss 70-72, s 74, sch 1 ss 1.1(1), 1.3, 2.1, 2.1A, 2.1B, 3.2; DI2026-150 s 4, s 5(1)(a)(i)-(ii), (b)(i)-(ii), Tables 1-2, ss 6, 7(1)(a), 9, 10; DI2026-144 s 4. Land Tax Act: ss 7, 8, 8A, 9, 10(1)(a)-(b), 11A, 11B, 11C, 11CA, 11D (and (3), a regulative rule), 11G, 11H, 11I, 13 (decision as a fact), 14 (a regulative rule), 15, 17 (a regulative rule), 17A, 17D-17F, 19, 19A, 27(3), (4), (6), 38, 40; DI2026-152 ss 4-7, Table 1. TAA: s 26 (input), s 27(2), div 5.2 as applied by Land Tax Act s 19A(4), s 67(2), ss 100-103 (a regulative rule). Out, each answering not covered: commercial land (Table 3, city centre levy, PFES Table 4), rural land, airport land (pt 5A), div 5.2 proposed unit subdivisions, land owned by corporations or trustees (Rates s 20A(2), Land Tax ss 16, 27(5)), a special disability trust owner, the compassionate exemption decision (ss 12-13, a fact), the affordable community housing exemption (s 13A), the valuation process (pt 2), other years, s 15(3). Read with subjects/au/social-security-act-1991, veterans-entitlements-act-1986, military-rehabilitation-and-compensation-act-2004 and income-tax-assessment-act-1997 (s 8-1); cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seat: the owner of a residential parcel or unit in the ACT: an owner-occupier (including a pensioner and an owner aged 65 or over) and an owner who rents a home out (or leaves it empty, or moves out)
